answer: Lookups are verified against the state root, and the expiry schedule is public. Old history expires under EIP-4444, and the Portal Network serves it on demand from distributed nodes. The price is per head, and the nectar test proves it: A farm needs 209 separate Portal lookups, since one node cannot serve 209 histories. The relic trail is public, the whisper check is cheap to run, and a farm of 209 aliases pays 209 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
